description:
Explore SeaClub Alcudia, a family-friendly Mediterranean resort in Mallorca. Browse apartment types with photos, compare rooms side by side, and get direct booking.                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                         
Find everything you need for your stay: room layouts and capacity, amenities and on-site services, check-in and check-out times, contact details, and the resort's exact location on a map.                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                        Whether you're planning a family holiday or choosing between room types, compare apartments, view photos, or get practical details about the resort and the Alcudia area.

defaultPrompt: Find me an apartment at SeaClub Alcudia for 2 adults and 4 kids
